title: Contact forces in a planar universe: the seed plane decays at t = 4 into two matter tracks at exact -1/2 and +1/2; an EM-like sign rule at contact, a confinement candidate between opposite signs, and a pull toward the seed (gravity-like candidate) without fall-off over D = 4 and 7
composition_note: every run is a mask of composition.json (one board, L = 16, registered generator all48_planes@1 only) or compositions/seed_L32.json (the seed plane alone on 2L = 32); every run declares the projection layer r18_line_y0z0_v1 (the records with y = z = 0 of its official log, lossless on planar boards by the exact y/z translation symmetry); seconds = replay times of the package verifier on a clean copy at load ~2.5

checks.text: the seed plane decays at t = 4 into two matter tracks at exact -1/2 and +1/2 (window [6, 12]): track 0 born at the seed's own site (origin seed), track 1 emitted from it
confinement candidate between opposite signs: a period-10 (= 4d - 2, d = 3) source at x = 1, between the + wall (x = 0) and the seed's dark home mark (x = 3)
reflection at the + wall with label flip: the right glider's track reaches x = 12.0 at t = 20 (wall at x = 13) and is back at x = 7.5 at t = 32; it has C1 clicks, the free glider none
the free glider (seed alone) clicks only C2
a pull toward the seed (gravity-like candidate) on a visible clock: on the full board the clock is a period-6 source at x = 6, window [9, 29], phases (from the window start) 0, 2, 3, 5

no seed: the lone clock is the only source, period 6 at x = 7, window from t = 1, phases 0, 2, 3, 5; so with the seed it sits 1 site closer to the seed and its absolute phases (window start + phase, mod 6) are 2 updates late; no track
the full board also holds the confined left glider: a period-10 source at x = 1
no fall-off over D = 4 and 7: with dark textures at D = 4 and D = 7 the same two-update kink appears at both (t = 7, 10 and 13, 16), and again on the way back (t = 26, 29, 32)
the walls-only reference path at the same updates (free glider in the box)
dark textures and walls alone (no seed): no click
